properties.name: Air Force Station Monkey Point Radar Buffer
properties.description: IAF High-Altitude Defense Radar Installation. Civilian crossing prohibited within 250m perimeter.

properties.name: Chail Wildlife Sanctuary - Leopard Breeding Core
properties.description: Critical wildlife conservation core. High leopard and Himalayan black bear activity.

properties.name: Jim Corbett National Park - Dhikala Core Incursion Zone
properties.description: Strict Tiger Reserve Core Sanctuary. Foot safari prohibited under Wildlife Protection Act.

properties.name: Nanda Devi Biosphere - Rishi Ganga Glacial Fracture Zone
properties.description: Active glacial fracture and unstable moraine slope. Danger of sudden outburst flood.

properties.name: Valley of Flowers - Core Alpine Preservation Sector
properties.description: Protected UNESCO Biosphere. Off-trail camping and specimen collection strictly penalized.

properties.name: Dzukou Valley Southern Bog & Sinkhole Sector
properties.description: Perilous subterranean peat bog and flash sinkhole zone. Entry restricted without licensed guide.

properties.name: Khangchendzonga High Glacier Crevasse Field
properties.description: Deep transverse glacier crevasses. Sub-zero avalanche zone; special mountain permit mandatory.

properties.name: Cherrapunji / Mawsmai Cave Subterranean Flood Chasm
properties.description: Rapidly flooding karst caverns. Complete closure during precipitation episodes.

properties.name: Silent Valley National Park Core Kunthipuzha Sector
properties.description: Preserved evergreen rainforest core. Lion-tailed macaque habitat with restricted access.

properties.name: Bandipur Tiger Reserve Elephant Migration Corridor
properties.description: Night Elephant migration artery across NH-766. Strict night-curfew buffer.
